acceptance_semantics.binding_rule: ECONOMIC_SKILL_EVIDENCE_PRESENT requires H1 AND H2 AND a beat against NO_ACTION AND an independent cohort count >= 10. Meeting the portfolio criterion alone yields ECONOMIC_SKILL_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
acceptance_semantics.note: VS-001 used the single word SUPPORTED, which invited exactly the conflation the operator caught. VS-002 separates the criterion from the conclusion.

hypotheses.H1_portfolio_skill: Risk-adjusted signal performance exceeds the frozen risk-matched benchmark after friction.
hypotheses.H2_ranking_skill: Signal score is positively associated with subsequent risk-adjusted return (Spearman IC > 0).
hypotheses.separation_rule: H1 and H2 are judged independently and never collapsed. VS-001 satisfied a portfolio-level criterion with IC = -0.059, which is precisely the case a single blended claim would have hidden.

intended_benchmarks: market: SPY over the identical interval
NO_ACTION / cash: the risk-free return over the identical interval, which answers whether deploying capital beat doing nothing

intended_friction.components: 5 bps entry + 5 bps exit (half-spread plus slippage)
intended_friction.execution_delay: Zero assumed, which flatters the strategy; declared rather than hidden.
intended_friction.justification_for_reuse: Carried forward from VS-001 because the instruments are unchanged - large-cap US equities and liquid ETFs, where 5 bps per side is conservative-to-realistic. It is NOT reused because it was convenient: the repository contains no measured execution cost anywhere, so any number here is an assumption and is labelled as one. It must never be reported as observed market cost.

intended_leakage_controls: beta estimation window ends strictly before signal_time
outcome snapshots refused by the EvidenceGateway before their resolution instant, as proven in VS-001 (440/440 refused)
no forward or contemporaneous bar may enter risk estimation
corporate-action adjusted closes required, since a split inside a 252-day beta window corrupts the estimate
survivorship: the recorded watchlist is fixed and not re-queried
intended_metrics: cohort-level mean risk-adjusted excess return, with interval
Spearman IC of signal_score vs risk-adjusted return
IC uncertainty (NOTE: no IC standard error exists anywhere in the repo; strat_lab_adapter.py gates promotion on ic >= 0.05 as a bare point estimate. VS-002 would have had to add one.)
independent cohort count reported beside every interval

intended_risk_adjustment.definition: excess = r_stock - [rf + beta_i * (r_SPY - rf)], with beta_i estimated by OLS of stock daily excess returns on SPY daily excess returns over a lookback ending strictly before the signal timestamp.
intended_risk_adjustment.estimation_window: 252 trading days ending strictly before signal_time
intended_risk_adjustment.pit_boundary: Only bars with known_at <= signal_time may enter the estimation window. Contemporaneous and forward bars are structurally excluded, enforced by the EvidenceGateway rather than by convention.

rejected_alternatives.Fama-French factor attribution: REJECTED as infeasible: portfolio_sim/factor_attribution.py exists and is tested but requires MONTHLY returns and gates at >= 9 months; the scored window is 9.5 DAYS. Its input data/factors/ff_monthly.csv does not exist.
rejected_alternatives.beta from price_at_signal quotes: REJECTED as not credible - see measured_feasibility. This is the option that was closest to computable, and computing it would have produced a falsely precise number from 4-6 usable point-in-time observations.
rejected_alternatives.sector-matched benchmark: REJECTED as infeasible: sector_mapping.py covers 3 of 22 tickers (XLE/XLK/XLF); the 19 single names resolve only via data/fmp_cache/profile_stable_<SYM>.json, and that cache is empty.
rejected_alternatives.stock_minus_SPY (VS-001 method): REJECTED by the operator and by evidence - it is not a risk adjustment at all and permits beta to masquerade as skill.
rejected_alternatives.volatility-matched benchmark: REJECTED as infeasible: realized volatility needs >= 15 observations per vol_regime_advisor._MIN_OBSERVATIONS; the available series yields 10-13 non-degenerate observations, and far fewer once a pre-signal window is reserved.

intended_risk_adjustment.why_this_method: It is the simplest adjustment that separates selection from exposure, and it directly answers the VS-001 confound: a high-beta basket beats SPY mechanically in a rising market.

rejected_alternatives.HAC / Newey-West: REJECTED: absent from the repo, scipy and statsmodels are not installed, and a bandwidth exceeding the effective series length would dress 2 independent windows in arithmetic.
rejected_alternatives.block bootstrap: REJECTED: a block bootstrap over 2 blocks has 3 distinct resamples.

intended_sampling.rule: Non-overlapping 7-day cohorts: a cohort may begin only after the previous cohort's outcome window has closed.
intended_sampling.sample_count_interpretation: The independent unit is the cohort, NOT the ticker-row and NOT the scan. Tickers within a cohort share one market interval.
intended_sampling.why: VS-001 clustered by scan, which fixes cross-sectional correlation within a scan but not serial correlation between scans one day apart with a 7-day horizon (~6/7 overlap).

attempted_design.purpose: Attack the methodological weaknesses VS-001 exposed: no risk adjustment, heavily overlapping horizons, and a portfolio-level result being mistaken for ranking skill.
attempted_design.research_question: Do the watchlist signals predict positive risk-adjusted 7-day excess returns, and does signal strength positively rank subsequent risk-adjusted outcomes, under a sampling design that does not treat overlapping horizons as independent evidence?

authority_statement: This artifact grants nothing. It records that an experiment was designed and deliberately not run, and what would be required to run it.

blockers: only 2 non-overlapping 7-day cohort(s) exist in a 9.5-day scored window; 10 is the minimum for an interval estimate that is not wider than the effect
risk estimation has 10-13 usable joint return observations per ticker, below this repository's own volatility gate of 15 and far below its correlation gate of 30
no durable price history: outputs/backtest/historical does not exist, so no pre-signal estimation window can be constructed
observation intervals are not comparable: gaps range 0.02h to 31.39h, so consecutive 'returns' are not identically scaled and a beta over them is biased toward zero

minimum_evidence_contract.corporate_actions: REQUIRED for this contract specifically, because beta is estimated over a 252-day window. Not required for VS-001, which read a pre-computed 7-day outcome.

coverage_required.forward: sessions covering each signal_time + 7 calendar days, so the outcome and the risk adjustment are measured on the same calendar
coverage_required.history: >= 252 trading sessions ending before the EARLIEST signal timestamp, so every signal has a full pre-signal estimation window
coverage_required.symbols: all 22 recorded watchlist tickers plus SPY

deterministic_validation: every bar tz-aware and admitted through the gateway
no gap longer than 5 sessions inside a claimed continuous window
adj_close/close ratio monotone within a corporate-action-free span
session coverage >= 252 before the earliest signal, asserted not assumed
a lookahead probe: every bar refused at an as_of before its known_at, in the style of the VS-001 refusal ledger
minimum_evidence_contract.name: minimum historical price evidence contract
minimum_evidence_contract.pit_semantics: Bars are admitted through the existing EvidenceGateway. A bar with known_at > as_of is refused. No bar may be synthesized, forward-filled across a gap, or back-dated.
minimum_evidence_contract.provenance: Each bar carries a DataSourceDescriptor with pit_capability declared honestly. A vendor endpoint that cannot state when a value became knowable is pit_capability=none and cannot back a PIT experiment.
minimum_evidence_contract.purpose: The narrowest durable evidence that unblocks VS-002. This is a data requirement, not a market-data platform.

required_fields_per_bar.adj_close: float, adjusted for splits AND dividends. REQUIRED, not optional: a split inside a 252-day beta window silently destroys the estimate, and this repository currently delegates adjustment to a vendor field it does not verify.
required_fields_per_bar.known_at: timestamp at which the bar became knowable. For a daily close this is at earliest the session close, never the session open.
required_fields_per_bar.known_at_basis: one of the PointInTime basis values; source_reported preferred, derived_conservative acceptable, unknown REFUSED
required_fields_per_bar.session_date: ISO date of the trading session
required_fields_per_bar.source_id: DataSourceDescriptor id of the producing adapter
required_fields_per_bar.volume: int, for a liquidity sanity check only

minimum_evidence_contract.storage: Durable and queryable by (symbol, session_date) and by as_of. This is the first genuine demand for the 0C Research Store: VS-001 held 420 snapshots in memory, but a 252-day window x 23 symbols is ~5,800 bars per experiment and must not be re-fetched per run.

narrowest_unblocking_task: Implement a daily adjusted-close evidence adapter plus durable storage satisfying minimum_evidence_contract, for 23 symbols with >= 252 pre-signal sessions. That is a bounded 0C task and is NOT authorized by this mission.
summary: VS-002 was designed to completion and NOT executed. Four independent, measured blockers make a credible risk adjustment impossible from data durable in this repository today. Executing it anyway would have produced a falsely precise number and would have been less honest than the VS-001 result it was meant to correct.
